reasoning: Jelena's body begins to echo the Voivode of Ash's own hollow, cinder-grey stillness. New Skill reflects this inherited trait; the Experience joins Memory V, which already holds her turning.

operations.name: Standing Still as Ash
operations.description: I can hold utterly motionless for hours, the way the Voivode does, until even rats forget I am there

operations.text: My skin dries to the grey of cold ash and I learn to stand as still as the Voivode himself, motionless in doorways until even rats forget I am there — I feel him settling further into my bones.
